sources.title: abliteration.org - catalog of abliterated LLMs
sources.snippet: abliteration.org is an independent catalog and analytics resource for the abliterated and uncensored language-model market. Every model is registered with a precise timestamp and an inventory number, and the whole dataset is refreshed continuously.

sources.title: Qwen3.6 27B AEON Ultimate Uncensored FP8 MTP — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A community-fine-tuned variant of Qwen's 27B model with censorship filters removed, running in FP8 precision with multi-token prediction. It accepts both text and image inputs, making it multimodal. The uncensored nature means it will engage with a broader range of prompts without refusals, though this also means standard safety guardrails are absent.
